objectives.name: time_growth
objectives.semantics: The exact rational g(B_T) in rules.md for the full proved total-work upper envelope in claim 0. Review full-secret correctness and all three bounds jointly. This is a coarse UI index, not an optimal-time exponent or proof of the 1/3 target.

objectives.name: classical_space_growth
objectives.semantics: The exact rational g(B_C) in rules.md for the proved peak classical-bit upper envelope in claim 1, for the same algorithm/configuration. Zero does not by itself certify polynomial space.

objectives.name: quantum_space_growth
objectives.semantics: The exact rational g(B_Q) in rules.md for the proved peak quantum-qubit upper envelope in claim 2, for the same algorithm/configuration. Zero does not by itself certify polynomial space.

scoring.instructions: Apply rules.md. Accept a score-source claim ID only after proving the whole bound statement and its nonnegative finite rational growth index. All three claims must refer to one algorithm/configuration with joint bounds. Return scores:null; the shared verifier derives the vector from accepted IDs.

validity.instructions: Apply rules.md to correctness, unconditional full-secret success and charged worst-case resources. Valid scoped partial theorems may remain unscored. An unsupported stronger expression is not accepted merely because a weaker expression would have the same index.
